description:
Closes the executor's public surface to its constructors and family facade accessors, making the shared kernel crate-private, so no consumer outside `crates/jit` can bypass a family facade.

## Background

With every family reached through a facade (`CommandExecutor::issues()` returning `IssueOps<'_, S>`, and its peers), the kernel in `crates/jit/src/commands/mod.rs` is still public: `repository_layout`, `storage`, `rules`, `effective_rules`, `require_active_lease`, and the `pub config_manager: ConfigManager` field. `require_worktree_paths`, `require_layout`, `publish_repository_export`, `plan_repository_export`, `refuse_foreign_leases` and `refuse_foreign_lease` are kernel too and are already `pub(crate)`. The server reaches past the facades through them: `crates/server/src/routes.rs` calls `state.executor.storage()` to feed `jit::config_manager::get_hierarchy_config`, `repository_layout()`, and reads `.config_manager` at four sites (`get_namespaces` three times, `get_hierarchy_icons` once). Integration tests call `executor.storage()` in about 16 files.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The public methods of `CommandExecutor` are its constructors (`new`, `with_layout`, `with_worktree_paths`) and the family accessors; kernel methods are `pub(crate)`, and `config_manager` is a private field.
- [hard] REQ-02: The server's hierarchy-config, namespace, icon and layout reads go through facade methods, and it uses no kernel item; test-only access to storage is gated on `cfg(test)` or the `test-support` feature.
- [hard] REQ-03: A source-policy test in `crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/` (`test_command_executor_public_surface_is_constructors_and_accessors`) scans the `impl CommandExecutor` blocks under `crates/jit/src/commands/` and fails when a `pub fn` there is neither a constructor nor returns a facade type, and the Rust workspace builds and passes its existing suites with no assertion weakened.

## Notes

- A compile-fail doctest is not used; the policy test is the observable check.
- Server response shapes and statuses are unchanged.
- Design rationale: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/plan.md` (D-1, D-11); method inventory: `dev/active/df129d9e-rust-code-quality/investigation.md` area 3.
title: Crate-private executor kernel
